privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: SAPIRO privacy policy: what data the app, the online game and the website process, why, with which providers, and your rights.
privacy.intro: Sapiro is published by Agence Debord EURL (Paris, France). This policy explains, without jargon, what data the app, the online game on sapiro.app and the website process, why, and what you can do about it. We never sell data and we show no ads.

sections.title: Your account and progress
sections.content: When you first open the app (or the online game), an anonymous account is created. You can then sign in with Apple, Google or an email address and password: we then receive your email address and the identifier provided by these services, so you can find your progress on all your devices. Your username, avatar, your device's country and your progress (games, scores, streaks, trophies, trail steps) are stored on our servers, located in Germany (European Union).

sections.title: Duels
sections.content: When you play a duel game, your answers (right or wrong, response time) are recorded so they can be replayed against other players for up to 90 days. Your opponent then sees your username, avatar, your country's flag and your number of trophies. They never see your name or email address.

sections.title: The welcome questionnaire
sections.content: At first launch, the app asks a few optional questions: your first name, age range, gender, what motivates you, how many quizzes you aim for each week and your reminder time. Every question can be skipped. Your first name stays on your device and is never sent. The other answers are linked to a pseudonymous identifier in our analytics tool, to understand who uses Sapiro and improve the app.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.content: We use PostHog, hosted in the European Union, to measure how the app, the online game and the website are used: screens and pages viewed, games played, subscription screens, purchases, technical errors, device model, language, version, landing page and source (link, campaign). This data is linked to a pseudonymous identifier, never to your name or email address. We do not record your sessions. On the website, we also use Umami, a visit statistics tool we host ourselves. Neither sets cookies.

sections.title: Campaign measurement
sections.content: To know which ad campaigns bring installs and subscriptions, the app uses Singular. Singular receives technical information about the device (model, system, IP address, app-specific identifier) and a few key steps (install, sign-up, first game, trial start, subscription); it passes conversion results to ad networks (Meta, TikTok, Apple), without your name or email. On iOS, measurement goes through Apple's SKAdNetwork: we do not ask for tracking permission and do not use the advertising identifier. On Android, the app does not access the advertising identifier. On iPhone, RevenueCat also receives the Apple Search Ads attribution token.

sections.title: Subscriptions and purchases
sections.content: In the app, purchases are made through the App Store or Google Play. In the online game, payment is processed by RevenueCat and Stripe: we pass your account email address for the receipt. We never see your bank details. RevenueCat keeps your purchase history and subscription status to activate Sapiro+ on all your devices.

sections.title: Your messages
sections.content: When you write to us from “Contact us”, we receive your message, its type (bug, idea, mistake), the app version, platform and language. We use them only to fix and improve Sapiro.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.content: If you allow them, reminders (daily challenge, streak, end of trial) are scheduled locally on your device. No data is sent to deliver them. You can turn them off at any time in your phone settings.

sections.title: On your device
sections.content: The app and the online game store your session, settings, questionnaire answers and offline progress locally. On the website and the online game, this information is kept in the browser's local storage, not in cookies.

sections.title: Who we share data with
sections.content: Only our service providers, for the uses described above: Supabase (database, our servers in Germany), PostHog (analytics, EU), Singular (campaign measurement), RevenueCat and Stripe (subscriptions), Apple and Google (sign-in, purchases), Cloudflare (website hosting). Some of these providers may process data outside the European Union; they do so under the safeguards provided by the GDPR (standard contractual clauses or the Data Privacy Framework).

sections.title: Retention
sections.content: Your account, progress and duel games are kept as long as the account exists; a game is no longer offered as a duel after 90 days. Analytics data is kept for at most two years. Purchase data is kept for as long as our accounting obligations require.

sections.title: Deleting your account
sections.content: In the app: Profile tab, “Delete my account”. On the web: open sapiro.app/en/play/?delete-account, sign in, then confirm the deletion (or, in the online game, open the Account window and choose “Delete my account”). This immediately erases your account, username, progress, duel games and trophies. Messages sent through “Contact us” are kept without being linked to you. Deleting your account does not cancel an active subscription: cancel it first where you bought it. To also erase analytics, campaign and purchase data, write to bonjour@agencedebord.com: we handle requests within 30 days.

sections.title: Children
sections.content: Sapiro is made for the whole family, children included. For younger players, we made simple choices: no ads, no advertising identifier, no messaging between players, an optional account, and the first name entered at welcome never leaves the device. In duels, a player appears to others only through their username, avatar, country flag and trophies. Purchases go through the App Store or Google Play, with their parental controls. A parent can at any time request access to or deletion of their child's data by writing to bonjour@agencedebord.com.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.content: Under the GDPR, you can access, correct or delete your data, object to its processing or request its portability. Write to bonjour@agencedebord.com. If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr), the French data protection authority.

sections.title: Changes
sections.content: This policy may be updated. The date at the top of the page shows the latest version.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: Agence Debord EURL, 9 rue des Colonnes, 75002 Paris, France — bonjour@agencedebord.com.

sections.title: 11. Subscriptions and In-App Purchases
sections.content:
SAPIRO offers optional premium subscriptions that unlock additional features.

Available Plans

  • Monthly Subscription: $1.99 per month
  • Annual Subscription: $19.99 per year
  • Lifetime Purchase: $39.99 (one-time payment)

Billing Terms

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account (for iOS) or Google Play account (for Android) upon confirmation of purchase.

Automatic Renewal

Monthly and annual subscriptions automatically renew. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the current subscription rate.

Cancellation

You can cancel automatic renewal at any time, at least 24 hours before the end of the current period:

  • On iOS: Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions
  • On Android: Google Play Store > Menu > Subscriptions

Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period. You will retain access to premium features until that date.

Lifetime Purchase

The "Lifetime" option is a one-time purchase (not a subscription) that provides permanent access to all premium features, with no renewal or additional fees.

Free Trial

Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about SAPIRO: is it really free? Is it safe for kids? Privacy, content
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SAPIRO

items.question: Is SAPIRO really free?
items.answer: Yes, and ad-free. Every day you get 3 free games (duels included) and the Daily Challenge, across all 5 worlds. Sapiro+ unlocks unlimited games and every path.

items.question: Is it safe for my child?
items.answer: SAPIRO contains no ads and never sells data. No advertising cookies, no required account, no third-party content. Your child can play independently.

items.question: Does SAPIRO work offline?
items.answer: Quizzes work without a connection: all content is downloaded with the app. You can play on a plane, in the subway, or while camping. Only duels and content updates require the network.

items.question: What subjects does SAPIRO cover?
items.answer: Four domains: geography (197 countries, flags, capitals), history (500+ historical figures), art (553 major artworks), and nature (600 animal species). Over 2,000 questions in total, each with an explanation.

items.question: Does SAPIRO collect my data?
items.answer: Only what's needed, and we never sell anything. No ads, no advertising cookies. We measure usage (games played, pages viewed) to improve Sapiro. An account is optional: it only saves your progress and subscription.

items.question: Is SAPIRO available on iOS and Android?
items.answer: Yes. SAPIRO is available on the App Store (iPhone, iPad) and Google Play (Android). The app is identical on both platforms.

items.question: Are the questions verified?
items.answer: Yes. Every question is written and verified manually. The content is not community-generated: it is reviewed to ensure accuracy.

items.question: Is SAPIRO suitable for adults?
items.answer: SAPIRO is designed for all ages. The content covers world geography, history, major artworks, and biodiversity. Many adults use it to test and expand their general knowledge.

about.title: About SAPIRO
about.text: SAPIRO is a free, ad-free educational quiz app for iOS and Android, developed by Agence Debord EURL (Paris, France). It covers five domains: geography (197 countries), history (500+ historical figures), art (553 major artworks), nature (600 animal species), and monuments (500 monuments). The app includes over 2,000 manually verified questions, each with an explanation. It includes a Duel mode against other players. No ads, and data is never sold. The app is available in French, English, and Spanish.
